name: Mikhail Gorbachev
role: Soviet leader (1985–1991), USSR president (1990–1991) and later social-democratic advocate
summary: Gorbachev’s mature outlook combined competitive democracy, civil freedoms and a socially regulated market economy. He promoted disarmament, international cooperation and environmental protection, while his later support for Crimea’s transfer to Russia reflected his emphasis on the referendum’s claimed popular choice.
